name: aesthetic-direction
title_zh: 先定审美方向再写样式的网页设计器
tagline_zh: 受够了换个项目就换一套默认模板？它逼你先选一个方向，再从方向推导字体、配色、间距、布局和动效，成品不像框架默认值。
tagline_en: Tired of every page looking like the same framework default? It forces one direction, then derives type, color.
desc_en: Give a web interface a deliberate visual identity — choose one direction, then derive type, colour, spacing, layout, and motion from it so the result does not read as a framework default. Use when designing or restyling pages, landing sites, dashboards, or components in HTML/CSS/React; not for terminal UIs, print, or brand-guideline documents.
why_zh: 不是给一堆样式选项让你挑，而是先锁定一个视觉方向，再让所有设计决策从方向里长出来——方向对了。
why_en: Instead of offering a pile of style options, it locks a visual direction first, then grows every design decision from it.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML/CSS/React 的网页界面；终端 UI、印刷品、品牌规范文档不适用。它给方向与推导逻辑。
limit_en: Only for web UIs in HTML/CSS/React; not for terminal, print, or brand guidelines. It yields direction & rationale, not deployable code.
title_en: Pick one aesthetic direction, then derive every style from.
